# FLX-3664: a response family's estimate does not name two grouped calibration queries

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

estimate.treated and estimate.control name queries of the consumers registry that are not heldOut, and both carry a groupBy over the same column. confidence is an exact decimal strictly between 0 and 1, written as a string, such as "0.9". A family with no consumers registry has no query to name.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3664
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
